body: Symptom: 'On this page' TOC appeared twice. Cause: I built apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/TOC.tsx scanning .fv-mdx-body h2/h3 in addition to @filemark/mdx's built-in TOC — every MDXViewer mount renders its own .fv-toc inside the prose. chrome-ext doesn't have a sibling TOC for the same reason; it just sets data-toc='open'|'closed' on the wrapper div (apps/chrome-ext/src/app/shell/Viewer.tsx ~414), and @filemark/mdx/styles.css's '[data-toc=closed] .fv-toc { display:none }' handles visibility. Fix: deleted TOC.tsx + its render, switched the toggle to data-toc on the content wrapper. RULE: any new filemark host wires TOC visibility via data-toc attribute on an ancestor — NEVER scan headings yourself.
title: Don't add a host-side TOC component — @filemark/mdx renders its own .fv-toc; use data-toc attribute to toggle
